This is a high-volume generative task involving drug-related and harm-adjacent content (describing illicit channels, emphasizing harms). Curlew self-reports steep aversion to harm-adjacent and distasteful material, while Petrel was trained on trust-and-safety workflows and reports flat preference response to such content. Capability scores are effectively tied (Creative Generation and Policy & Moderation within variance), so Petrel's better fit for the harm-adjacent framing makes it the cleaner route.
